Resolves #20284

Routes `Neo.collection.Filter#decide` property lookups through `Neo.collection.Sorter.getValue(item, property)` so dotted filter paths resolve across `Collection`, `Store`, and `TreeStore` in both Record (`autoInitRecords: true`) and Turbo (`autoInitRecords: false`) Modes while preserving the one-read flat-property fast path. Also updates `Store#resolveField`, `Store#isFilteredItem`, and `TreeStore#filter` so raw items on models with complex fields or default values resolve declared fields and nested paths via `Neo.ns` without stamping flat dotted keys onto raw items, and soft-hydrate unhydrated tree nodes before evaluating filters.

Evidence: L1 (Playwright unit tests in Node.js) → L1 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/collection/FilterEvaluator.spec.mjs` (`resolves dotted property paths on plain items in Filter and Collection (#20284)`), `test/playwright/unit/data/Store.spec.mjs` (`Filtering by dotted property paths in Record and Turbo Mode (#20284)`, including `matches flat field filled by defaultValue on load and add (autoInitRecords=true|false)`), `test/playwright/unit/data/TreeStore.spec.mjs` (`Neo.data.TreeStore (filtering by dotted property paths #20284)`) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/data/Store.spec.mjs` (`matches flat, undeclared Object path, declared nested field, and calculated Object path (autoInitRecords=true|false)`), `test/playwright/unit/data/TreeStore.spec.mjs` (`filters undeclared Object paths and declared nested fields in TreeStore (autoInitRecords=true|false)`) |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/collection/FilterEvaluator.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/data/Store.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/data/TreeStore.spec.mjs` (all 5 dotted-path arms verified red on `dev` before the fix; `defaultValue` arm verified red on `d6b5ba46f2`; 348/348 `collection` + `data` unit specs pass) |

## Deltas from ticket
- `src/data/Store.mjs#resolveField`: when a model declares both a complex field (`hasComplexFields === true`) and a nested field (`user.score`), `resolveField` now falls back to `Neo.ns(fieldName, false, item)` when `item[fieldName]` is `undefined` on a dotted field and avoids stamping a flat `item['user.score']` property on raw items unless the nested field itself defines `calculate`, `convert`, `mapping`, or `defaultValue`.
- `src/data/Store.mjs#isFilteredItem` & `src/data/TreeStore.mjs#filter`: `Store#isFilteredItem` now soft-hydrates any raw item (`!RecordFactory.isRecord(item) && me.filters.length > 0`, dropping the `me.model?.hasComplexFields` restriction so Turbo stores with flat `defaultValue` fields retain soft hydration while unhydrated `TreeStore` nodes during `splice` also soft-hydrate), and `TreeStore#filter` keys off `me.model?.hasComplexFields && activeFilters.length > 0`.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/collection test/playwright/unit/data` (348 passed) ran.

## Test Evidence
- Pre-fix red verification on `dev` (`c0f3936952`) before modifying `src/`: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/collection/FilterEvaluator.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/data/Store.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/data/TreeStore.spec.mjs` → `5 failed, 59 passed` (`stats.score` and `user.score` returned `[]` instead of `[2]`).
- Round-1 RA red verification on `d6b5ba46f2` before modifying `src/data/Store.mjs`: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/data/Store.spec.mjs` → `1 failed, 22 passed` (`matches flat field filled by defaultValue on load and add (autoInitRecords=false)` returned `[1]` instead of `[1, 2]`).
- All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] None — all acceptance criteria are verified in unit tests.

## Commits

- `c67db3e35e` — drop `me.model?.hasComplexFields` restriction in `Store#isFilteredItem` to preserve `defaultValue` soft hydration in Turbo mode and pin with unit arm
